1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said composition is formulated for delayed gelling in oil and gas reservoir applications__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __selected from zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, or zirconium acetylacetonate__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine __having a molecular weight of 600 Da to 1800 Da__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, __wherein said polyanion has a molecular weight greater than 10,000 Da__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, __aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions __in a concentration of 0.1% to 5% by weight__.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about __200 to 900__ nm in diameter.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater __for delayed release applications__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __of less than 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron __and configured for controlled release of crosslinking agents__.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __crosslinker for delayed gelling applications__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al __in complexed form__.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __having anionic sites__ that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer __having a molecular weight of at least 100,000 Da__.

23) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __having a degree of hydrolysis of 10% to 40%__.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __or N,N-dimethylacrylamide having crosslinkable anionic sites__.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater __having a salinity of at least 1000 ppm__.
